facets.description: getClientsWithPermission (ClientPermissionsV2 lines 138-142) adds the name of the type-level "Clients" resource to the result instead of real client IDs when an all-clients permission grants the scope
Per-client resources have no type attribute set (AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource), so findByType misses them and per-client grants are not returned

The caller (AvailableRoleMappingResource.getRoleIdsWithPermissions) looks up each returned ID with realm.getClientById(cid) and dereferences it, so the bogus "Clients" entry causes a NullPointerException / 500 error
